prompt: Rewrite this chat message to a client so it is polite and clear. Keep every fact.

task.prompt: Rewrite the message for the client. Keep the facts, lose the blame.
task.sourceText: not our fault. your API was down all morning so nothing got tested. we'll see tomorrow maybe.

rubric.label: Keeps the facts
rubric.description: Says their API was down this morning and testing could not run.

rubric.label: Polite, no blame
rubric.description: States the cause as a fact, without blaming the client.

rubric.label: Gives a clear next step
rubric.description: Says when testing will run and when they will hear back.

task.sampleAnswer: Your API was down this morning, so testing couldn't run. We'll retest first thing tomorrow and update you by noon.

prompt: Email the client: Thursday's demo has to move to Friday. Ask them to confirm.

task.prompt: Write the body of the email.
task.context: The demo was booked for Thursday at 3 pm. Friday at 3 pm is free on our side.

rubric.label: States the change
rubric.description: Says the demo moves from Thursday to Friday.

rubric.label: Asks them to confirm
rubric.description: Ends with a clear request to confirm.

task.sampleAnswer: Hi Sam, we need to move Thursday's demo to Friday at 3 pm. Could you confirm that works for you?
